Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer relied on a misleading search snippet/knowledge panel that incorrectly attributed the 1976 Italian film Cross Shot (La legge violenta della squadra anticrimine) to Alvin Rakoff, likely conflating it with Rakoff’s 1969 film Crossplot. The agent failed to open and verify authoritative sources (e.g., the actual Wikipedia page) to confirm the correct director. This misidentification led the Planner to conclude the directors were from different countries, whereas the correct director of Cross Shot is Italian, making both directors from the same country.
